summary: Retest iteration_9 bug fix: 'Voltar' button in FichaAnalise renderAnalises when arriving via bridge (Ordem Produção -> Resultado da Análise) previously threw 'Cannot read properties of null (reading items)' because setView('items') was called with selectedCategory=null. Fix applied conditional: if selectedCategory exists -> setView('items'); else -> setView('categories') and clear selectedItem. All 3 scenarios verified end-to-end on preview URL. No runtime errors captured.

test_results.bridge_flow_voltar: PASS - Clicking Resultado da Análise on OP navigates to /ficha-analise?productId=..., renders analises view with Voltar/Editar Campos/Nova Análise/Gerar Documentação. Clicking Voltar navigates to CATEGORIES view (new-category-btn visible, 1 category shown). No pageerror, no console error, no 'Cannot read properties' overlay.
test_results.normal_flow_regression: PASS - Menu -> /ficha-analise -> click Category (Desinfetantes) -> click item (Produto Teste) -> analises view -> click Voltar -> returns to ITEMS view (2 items visible, add-item-btn visible, 0 categories). No errors.
test_results.ordem_producao_regression: PASS - /fichas-analise loads 22 OPs, each with Gerar Documentação, Resultado da Análise, and Fechar buttons visible (22 each).

critical_code_review_comments: FichaAnalise.js is ~756 lines - consider splitting subviews (renderCategories/renderItems/renderAnalises/renderNewAnalise/renderEditFields) into separate components for maintainability.
useEffect at line 84 doesn't include pendingProductId in deps but conditionally acts on it - minor; works because pendingProductId only cleared inside the other effect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bridge fix from Ordem de Produção -> Ficha de Análise (via productId query param) is stable. Voltar on bridge-entry goes to categories; on normal-entry stays at items. 22 OPs exist in seed. Only 1 category 'Desinfetantes' with 2 products (Produto Teste, Refrigerante Cocaccc) is present.
